title: Microsoft Support Screwed Me Over | I Am Done With Xbox One
description: I am done with Xbox One! My Xbox One X was having major issues and was turning off by itself randomly, so I contacted Microsoft Support. Let's just say the customer service experience was anything but positive. Microsoft definitely screwed me over in the end with how this entire situation was handled.  Discord: https://discord.gg/asUErQF Twitter: https://twitter.com/Griffin_Gaming

asr.full_text: You know, I would really love to be playing Red Dead Redemption 2 right now, but, you know I just can't, and why you might ask that is the case. Well, it's because I just so happened to buy the game on my Xbox One X. And if you follow me on Twitter, you know exactly what has happened in the past week that has honestly pissed me off so much, and it's taken me awhile to kinda calm down and make this fucking video. And not just go off on a complete rant because honestly this is one of the shittiest customer service experiences I think I've ever and it's a damn shame, because I actually really like Xbox, I like the Xbox One, I love my Xbox One X, but, I think I'm fuckin' done with Microsoft, honestly! Like, after this customer service experience, I'm fuckin' done with Xbox, to be honest. So, basically, what happened, and if you follow me on twitter, you already know this, but, long story short, I was having an issue where the game of xbox would completely shut itself off when I played a video game. It was fine sitting on the home screen or something, but the second I put it under the load of actually playing a game, just every thirty or so minutes, it would shut itself off. And this kind of happened when I first got Black Ops 4. That is when I really started black ops 4, It didn't think much of it. But immediately it did and ended up running bad. Immediately after the game when Red Dead Redemption 2 came out, I started playing. the problem got even worse. It will shut itself off after 30 minutes, After 10 minutes, it became to the point where if I will just loaded up the game and walking around for 5 minutes, I will shut itself off. Weird thing is when I shut it off, I could not turn the console back on. Until I actually took the power cord out of the back of the console. I allowed it to sit for a little bit, Pl started to spin around and did not turn its back on. At this point I just realized there's something really messed up about this console. I'm gonna contact Xbox support and see if they can send me a replacement console. Because I was still under warranty... I heard like lots of people say that it was the Microsoft replace themselves. But I just me a replacement console so I contacted them and I got completely fucked over in this situation I don't think there's any other way to put it so basically I explained the problem to them they told me the typical steps like oh try unplugging it and plugging it back in I explained I've already done that at least 15 times today and it's not working I need to get this fixed So they said, oh you can send it in to have its service so I basically asked like how long is that going to take and they come back with a number of around 14 to 28 days once the console is received and that is fucking ridiculous It does not take a month to figure out if a fu-cking console is broken or not So I kept asking I'm like Can you give me an exchange? I don't think it's fair that I have to go without my console and the games that I've paid for for over a month while you all try to fix the console, when it's really no fault of my own that it's not working. I mean I didn't drop it. I didn't spill anything on it. It didn't get struck by lightning or anything like that. No. It was just the fact that the console was obviously defective and I'm guessing it was some sort of issue with the power supply Cause that's normally what's wrong when the console can't keep itself on So I kept asking him, like can you give me an exchange And he came out with this bullshit excuse like we don't offer exchanges any more, maybe they'll be back in the future, better than ever I think that was the exact line they used and it was just absolutely ridiculous because at the same time I was on Twitter talking to people who had had an experience within the last month of actually Exchanging their broken consoles, so that was complete and utter bullshit, and I knew it so I asked to talk to a manager I was told the exact same thing like oh yeah We don't do advanced exchanges anymore you could send it in and we'll try to fix it and If we can't replicate the exchanges anymore you can send it in and we'll try to fix it And, if we can't replicate the problem then we send your console back And if we can't fix your console we will give you a replacement So, Basically, I got completely fucked over and it was actually really funny too because, I actually have the, Xbox One X Project Scorpio edition The special Day One edition You know, for their hardcore fans Well, Basically I asked them, Like What if you all can't fix my console? What are you gonna do to compensate me for losing my limited edition Xbox One X that I had to preholder Day One and get? and basically they said, oh, we'll give you a month of Xbox Live. but We can't guarantee that. I mean, what a fucking joke. Like, I straight up told them that a month of Xbox Live is completely insulting and it's just unacceptable in my opinion I mean this whole experience was really shitty So basically I just said fine fix the console But I can assure you like this is the last Xbox console I'm ever buying from you like I'm done You've lost me as a customer I'm finished I've had enough but I also want to get a refund for red dead redemption 2 Because I wasn't even able to play the game my console would shut itself off every single time I tried to play Red Dead Redemption 2 so they're like oh well we have a new process for requesting refunds you have to submit an online form you can no longer call in to Microsoft support or actually go through the chat so I had to send in a form i basically explain like every time i try to put the game my console shuts itself off making the game unplayable well apparently Microsoft has changed their refund policy and my refund was denied not once but twice and just take a look at this email they sent me like I mean this looks like it came from a Chinese sweatshop with someone using a bootleg version of Google Translate I mean, what the fuck There are no spaces whatsoever in the text of this email And it's supposed to be a generic response Because the second one I got said the exact same thing Only there were a few more spaces in that one So, I mean, it just shows you the calibre of support you're getting with Microsoft Which in my opinion is just completely unacceptable And it's why I'm so pissed off They screwed me on the console and on the refund So, not only did I spend $100 on a game, I cannot even play I now am without my console for at least a month in the hopes that they can either replicate the problem, and either fix my console or give me a replacement or there's another possibility where they can't replicate the problem, and they send my console back to me and I am back where I started with a broken xbox with nothing but time lost. That is absolutely infuriating and this is probably the main reason why I am done with my xbox. I don't want to give this company any more money because they treated me the customer like I was the one at fault. They are punishing me for selling me a faulty product and they won't even give me a refund on a game that I can't even play Because the console they sold me is defective. I mean, it's just absolutely ridiculous So Microsoft guess what you lost me as a customer This will be my last xbox console as tempting as it is to sell it I'll probably just keep it just so I can play the games that I've already paid for because I think I bought like 300 plus digital games on Xbox One over this generation. So it's not like I'm some little customer or something. Like, they really fucked me over here. But, um, yeah, I mean, I'll just play the existing games I have, I'll play with my friends on the games I have, and I'll play Red Dead Redemption 2 because I was going to buy it on PS4, but since I can't get a refund, I'm not going to spend $100 again on Red Dead Redemption. So it absolutely sucks. I've got to wait at least a month in hundred bucks again on Red Dead Redemption, so it absolutely sucks I've got to wait at month in order to actually play red dead redemption Like the whole rest of the fucking world is doing right now. So yeah overall really shitty situation Microsoft completely threw me under the bus and I'm done I'm done with xbox to be completely honest but anyway guys Just wanted to make this video and talk about it because it has just been on my mind ever since it happened. And, i guess this is kind of a warning for you. If you have any problems with your xbox one, prepare to get completely fucked over by microsoft support. Because it's obvious they have changed their support policies, from what people have told me their experience was in the past. So um, yeah guys, if you all enjoyed this video i would greatly appreciate it if you would hit that like and if you're new to the channel make sure to subscribe I would also greatly appreciate that but anyway guys I wanna thank you all so much for watching as always and I will catch you guys next time.
